title: Ascend
description: Cover slide — hero wordmark with feature pills
speakerNotes: Welcome everyone. Today I'm going to show you how Ascend is modernizing retail operations for specialty businesses. We've built the only platform that handles point-of-sale, inventory, and B2B wholesale in one system — purpose-built for regulated verticals like cannabis, firearms, and specialty food. Let's dive in.

title: The Retail Operations Problem
description: Three pain points for specialty retail operators
speakerNotes: Specialty retailers are running their businesses on a patchwork of incompatible tools. Their POS doesn't talk to their inventory system, which doesn't talk to their wholesale platform. Every month they're doing manual reconciliation, losing sales to stockouts they didn't see coming, and failing compliance audits because their records are spread across three spreadsheets. This isn't a niche problem — it affects 80% of operators in regulated verticals.

title: The Ascend Platform
speakerNotes: Ascend is one platform with three deeply integrated modules. The POS terminal handles every customer transaction. Inventory Control gives operators real-time visibility across all locations. And Wholesale & B2B automates the supplier side of the business. Critically, all three share a single data layer — so when a sale happens at the terminal, inventory updates instantly, and reorder triggers fire automatically.

title: POS Terminal
description: Terminal features with checkout UI mockup
speakerNotes: Our terminal is built for speed. A trained cashier can ring up a full transaction in under 15 seconds. We support every payment method — cash, card, and digital wallets. The UI adapts to the store's compliance requirements automatically, so staff never have to remember which age-verification step applies to which product. Offline mode means the store keeps selling even during connectivity outages.

title: Inventory Control
description: Inventory table mockup with multi-location features
speakerNotes: Inventory is where operators lose the most money — either over-ordering and tying up cash, or under-ordering and missing sales. Ascend tracks every SKU across every location in real time. Our predictive reorder engine learns each location's velocity and suggests purchase orders before stockouts happen. Compliance reports that used to take a full day to prepare are now generated in seconds.

title: Wholesale & B2B
speakerNotes: On the supplier side, Ascend gives distributors and brands a branded ordering portal their retail customers can use directly. This replaces the phone-and-email order process that most of the industry still runs on. Operators get a single invoice view, net terms management, and automated reconciliation. For distributors, it dramatically reduces order errors and cuts accounts-receivable cycles in half.

title: Market Opportunity
description: Regulated vertical with three market characteristics
speakerNotes: We are targeting a $4.2 billion market opportunity across regulated retail verticals. These markets have three characteristics that create a durable moat: high compliance overhead that makes switching painful, strong network effects between retailers and their suppliers, and accelerating state-by-state legalization driving rapid new-store growth. We are the only platform built from day one to serve all three of these dynamics simultaneously.

title: Platform Metrics
description: Three hero stats: 2400+ orgs, 50M+ txn/mo, 99.99% uptime
speakerNotes: These numbers tell the story. More than 2,400 organizations process over 50 million transactions per month through Ascend. Our 99.99% uptime SLA isn't a marketing number — it's backed by our infrastructure architecture and our contractual commitments to enterprise customers. Month-over-month transaction volume has grown 18% consistently for the past six quarters.

title: Pricing
speakerNotes: We use a tiered SaaS model. Starter gets single-location operators live in under a day at a predictable monthly fee. Growth adds multi-location inventory sync and wholesale portal access — this is our highest-volume tier. Enterprise is for regional chains and distributors; pricing is custom and typically includes dedicated onboarding, compliance reporting packages, and an SLA with financial penalties. Average contract value for Enterprise is $48K annually.

title: Get Started
description: Closing slide with wordmark, tagline, and contact
speakerNotes: We're ready to move fast with the right partners. If you're an operator: we can have you live within 48 hours — your first month is on us. If you're an investor or distribution partner: let's schedule a deeper technical review and a reference call with one of our anchor customers. Thank you for your time — I'm happy to take questions.
